title: Exercise the query-map acceptance instrument on the EXACT PRODUCT-PRODUCED served bundle bytes, and falsify-or-pass the question_native_coverage_39113690481 admission-disclosure handoff on those same bytes.
why_this_question: v57 lane question item (2) orders this lane to FALSIFY-OR-PASS Product's question_native_coverage_39113690481 fix ON THE EXACT SERVED BYTES once it lands, using the same mapping-free discipline that made the original finding admissible, publishing before/after admission records side by side, and NOT to pre-empt or pause before the handoff is consumed.

The lane's own last accepted cycle (39200567493, accept 6652b1dc) recorded capability_milestones.query_map_bundle_production.still_incomplete[0] = 'never executed against a PRODUCT-produced bundle (only against bundles this lane builds)'. The accepted harness was therefore never exercised on the bytes it exists to judge.
User FAST MVP MODE: build the smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority benchmark that can falsify the product. This is that benchmark, on product bytes rather than lane-built bytes.
question: Do the ACCEPTED product's own served bundle bytes satisfy the query_result_bundle acceptance contract, and does the accepted Product admission code path close the question_native_coverage disclosure gap on those exact bytes?
hypothesis: H1 CONTRACT. On the exact served rebuilt-39027045675 bundles the lane-directive-required properties that are MEASURABLE from a single shipped artifact (duplicate suppression, source/URL validity, answer-citation containment, counter-label evidence support, FR/DE/IT language accounting, determinism) hold. H2 HANDOFF. The committed served .admissibility.json files (BEFORE) fire the frozen disclosure-gap predicate on de-kapitalverletzung, and re-running the ACCEPTED product admission code (verify_bundle(bundle, question=question_spec)) on the SAME bytes (AFTER) does NOT fire it, because the fix emits a severity=warning finding code carrying every under-covered term. H3 NON-VACUITY. The same checks are not vacuously true on these bytes: deliberately blanking counter_evidence and repointing one canonical_url each flip the corresponding check to false.
baseline: BEFORE arm only: the committed admission record shipped inside the served packet itself (results/product/gate_packet/rebuilt-39027045675/questions/<qid>.admissibility.json), which is what a jurist or the packet consumer actually reads. It is NOT re-derived. The lane's own 39200567493 cached-producer benchmark is loaded and republished BESIDE the product numbers, never in place of them.

population.name: the three served question_result_bundles of packet rebuilt-39027045675
population.note: These are the ONLY product-produced bundles available. No sampling, no selection, no slug mapping to the lane's frozen retrieval spec. The lane's frozen retrieval spec (rent-default, corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule, petty-theft-dismissal) is a DIFFERENT question population and is NOT joined to these bytes by any mapping.

mapping_free_discipline: No analyst slug, no frozen id set, no baseline record and no mapping of any kind is applied to these bytes. Every measurement is computed from the served artifact itself. Where the lane's frozen known-authority ids cannot legitimately apply to this population, the measurement is reported as NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON and never as a pass.

frozen_inputs.pin_rule: Every digest above is RE-HASHED before and after execution. Any mismatch is exit 2 (ENVIRONMENT_OR_MISMATCH). A digest is never re-derived, re-pinned or re-tuned inside the instrument.

legs.question: Do the measurable bundle-contract properties hold on the exact served bytes?
legs.uses: already-accepted evaluation/query_map/harness.py (sha256 616ab3d4...) — imported BY REFERENCE, never copied or edited

checks_not_measurable_on_served_bytes.geometry_preserved_after_enrichment: the served packet ships only the `complete` phase bundle; there is no `map_ready` artifact to compare against, so the accepted harness's initial-vs-final signature comparison is NOT MEASURABLE. Reported as NOT_MEASURED, never as a pass.
checks_not_measurable_on_served_bytes.progressive_phases: same reason: provenance.phase is `complete` for all three served bundles and no `map_ready` provenance exists in the packet.
checks_not_measurable_on_served_bytes.note: A NOT_MEASURED check is NOT a pass and NOT a bar. It is not counted in the L1 verdict.

legs.question: Are the counter-authority checks live on product bytes, or vacuously true because the product emits nothing?

controls.mutation: set counter_evidence='' on every counter-labelled decision
controls.if_it_does_not_fire: exit 2, the check is vacuous on this population

controls.mutation: repoint the first decision's canonical_url to an off-host https URL
controls.if_it_does_not_fire: exit 2, the check is vacuous on this population

legs.question: Does the accepted Product admission code path close the question_native_coverage_39113690481 disclosure gap on the exact served bytes?
legs.before_arm: the committed served <qid>.admissibility.json, byte-identical, sha256 pinned above
legs.after_arm: product.query.gate_admissibility.verify_bundle(bundle, question=<qid>.question.json) executed on the SAME bundle bytes, with the product code sha256 pinned above
legs.predicate: evaluation.question_native_transfer.disclosure_gap_predicate, the FROZEN predicate (sha256 ffb2c70f...) — imported BY REFERENCE, never re-implemented
legs.success_rule_frozen: HANDOFF_PASS requires ALL of: (a) the BEFORE arm fires disclosure_gap_predicate on at least one qid — otherwise the original finding is not reproduced and the test is NOT_MEASURED; (b) the AFTER arm fires it on ZERO qids; (c) on every qid where BEFORE had a non-empty under-covered set, AFTER carries a finding whose code is matched by the frozen DISCLOSURE_MARKERS and whose query_concepts_under_covered field equals the measured under-covered set exactly as a set; (d) that finding's severity is `warning` and the AFTER verdict's `admissible` is still true — a disclosure, never a refusal; (e) NO finding code present in the BEFORE arm is ABSENT from the AFTER arm (no silent regression).

falsification_classes.HANDOFF_PASS: success rule satisfied on all three qids
falsification_classes.HANDOFF_FIX_ABSENT: AFTER still fires the predicate — the accepted Product code does not close the gap on the served bytes
falsification_classes.HANDOFF_FIX_PARTIAL: predicate closed but condition (c) or (e) fails
falsification_classes.HANDOFF_TERMS_MISMATCH: finding present but its detail terms are not the measured under-covered set
falsification_classes.HANDOFF_SEVERITY_CHANGED: finding severity is not `warning`, or admissibility flipped
falsification_classes.HANDOFF_NOT_MEASURED: the BEFORE arm does not fire the predicate (the original finding is not reproduced on these bytes)

legs.non_vacuity_control: run the AFTER arm on a mutated bundle whose decision titles/regestes/snippets are emptied so the concepts are no longer under-covered; the query_concepts_under_covered finding MUST then be absent. If it is still present the finding is data-independent and the pass is void.

legs.question: What do the language, provenance and reproducibility properties of the served bytes actually say?
measures: per-language decision counts and the question-language share (REUSE of the accepted language-dominance / cross-language discipline; reported, not thresholded)
canonical_url host/scheme/null distribution and the unhydrated-shell explanation share
duplicate suppression by alnum-core (REUSE of the frozen duplicate rule, by reference)
determinism: file sha256 re-read, accepted-harness geometry_signature recomputed twice, and invariance of that signature under a seeded reversal of the decision array order
latency as recorded in the bundle provenance

metrics.secondary: L1 per-check status vector and L2 yield numerators/denominators
metrics.reporting_rule: every numerator and denominator is published. No metric is compared across the two question populations (lane cached-producer vs product served) as if they were the same population; where both are shown they are shown side by side with the population difference named.

success_rule.run_valid: exit 0 = VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION: all four legs completed, both non-vacuity controls fired, every pinned digest re-hashed unchanged, L1 has no measurable check false, and L3 verdict is HANDOFF_PASS.
success_rule.exit_1: PRODUCT_BUNDLE_CONTRACT_VIOLATED — a measurable L1 check is false on the served bytes
success_rule.exit_2: ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS — a pinned digest moved, the mount is absent, or a non-vacuity control did not fire
success_rule.exit_3: HANDOFF_FIX_FALSIFIED — L3 verdict is anything other than HANDOFF_PASS

known_divergence_disclosure: The lane's frozen retrieval benchmark answers a DIFFERENT question population (rent-default, corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule, petty-theft-dismissal) than the product's served packet (de-kapitalverletzung, fr-bail-entretien, it-responsabilita-medica). Therefore: (i) the lane's frozen known-authority and known-counter ids are NOT applied here; (ii) no known-relevant-authority or known-counter recall number may be published for the product population, because no mapping-free ground truth exists for it — this is reported as NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON, not as 0 and not as a pass; (iii) the lane's 39200567493 numbers are republished beside, never merged with or substituted for, the product numbers.

pre_freeze_disclosure.why_present: Full disclosure of an exploratory peek performed BEFORE this hypothesis was frozen, so the reader can discount the 'frozen-before-execution' property of L3.
pre_freeze_disclosure.what_was_done: While reading the accepted product mount to locate the served bytes, the operator ran product.query.gate_admissibility.verify_file() once per served bundle in an interactive shell, with a working directory of /tmp/lex_accepted/product, after installing numpy 2.5.4 and scikit-learn 1.9.1 / scipy 1.18.1 into the interpreter (they were absent). No evaluation-lane instrument was executed and no result file was written during that probe.
pre_freeze_disclosure.what_was_observed: de-kapitalverletzung: admissible True, warning_count 1, finding codes ['query_concepts_under_covered', 'counter_authority_has_product_owned_channel', 'source_url_host_distribution'], measured under-covered ['kapitalverletzung','uberwachungspflicht'], finding detail terms ['kapitalverletzung','uberwachungspflicht']. fr-bail-entretien and it-responsabilita-medica: warning_count 0, under-covered []. That probe called verify_file WITHOUT question=, so it also did not reproduce the two question-language findings present in the committed BEFORE arm.
pre_freeze_disclosure.effect_on_this_freeze: The L3 outcome was therefore NOT unknown at freeze time. This is a real weakening of the 'frozen before any execution' property for L3 and is stated rather than concealed. The formal run does not repair it: it re-derives both arms from committed bytes under pinned digests, applies the FROZEN predicate to both, and adds the two non-vacuity controls and the no-regression condition (e) that the interactive probe did not test. The result is still falsifiable — a stale or reverted Product admission module, a moved input digest, a regression in the other findings, or a vacuous always-on finding would each produce a non-zero exit.
pre_freeze_disclosure.l1_l2_l4_untouched: The peek did not measure L1, L2 or L4 at all. Those legs are frozen against genuinely unobserved outcomes.

claim_ceiling: This cycle may claim, at most, and only with a committed machine record: (1) that the ACCEPTED harness, run for the first time on PRODUCT-produced bytes, returns the stated per-check status vector for the three served bundles, with the two phase-dependent checks explicitly NOT_MEASURED; (2) that the question_native_coverage_39113690481 admission-disclosure fix fires on the exact served bytes under the accepted Product admission code, with before/after admission records published side by side and the frozen predicate applied to both; (3) the L2 yield numerators and denominators on product bytes. It may NOT claim: any known-authority or known-counter recall for the product population; that the map is useful to a jurist; that the human gate is closer to ready; anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND frozen bars, which stay REPORTED-ONLY and are re-hashed but not applied here; that the frontier-query-concept-recall OUTCOME_B numbers are confirmed or refuted by this run (its numbers are cited as its own, not re-measured); or that Product has adopted or declined any component.
zero_new_thresholds: This instrument introduces no threshold, bar or rubric. It reports numerators and denominators. It does not edit, re-derive, re-tune or paraphrase RULES_LABEL.json, RULES_GEOMETRY.json, the frozen retrieval spec, the freeze record or the frozen disclosure predicate.
forbidden: editing any accepted record, in place or otherwise
editing the served product bytes; the AFTER arm writes only into this lane's own results/ tree
mapping the product question slugs onto the lane's frozen retrieval questions
publishing a NOT_MEASURED or NOT_APPLICABLE cell as a pass
comparing the frontier-query-concept-recall numbers with this lane's own as if they measured the same population
